items.raw_excerpt: Every year, around 30,000 people pack their bags and leave Norway. While many are simply returning home, a major research project has uncovered a surprising factor driving these departures.
items.summary_en: Every year, about 30,000 people leave Norway. A large research project found a surprising main reason why foreigners decide to go.
items.summary_ko: 해마다 약 3만 명이 노르웨이를 떠납니다. 대형 연구 프로젝트가 외국인들이 떠나는 주된 이유로 놀라운 점을 찾아냈습니다.
items.title_en: Main reason foreigners leave Norway revealed
items.title_ko: 외국인들이 노르웨이를 떠나는 주된 이유 밝혀져
items.title_original: REVEALED: What's the main reason driving foreigners to leave Norway?

items.raw_excerpt: Chants of "fix the roads" could be heard alongside the roar of motorbikes outside state parliament as more than 3,000 attendees joined the rally.
items.summary_en: More than 3,000 riders on motorbikes gathered outside the state parliament in Victoria. They chanted "fix the roads" to demand action on potholes. The protest was organized by riders who say the bad roads put them in danger.
items.summary_ko: 오토바이 운전자 3천여 명이 빅토리아 주의회 앞에 모였다. 이들은 도로 파임을 막아달라며 "도로를 고치라"고 구호를 외쳤다. 참가자들은 열악한 도로가 자신들을 위험에 빠뜨린다며 이번 시위를 조직했다.
items.title_en: Thousands of motorcyclists join pothole rally outside Victorian parliament
items.title_ko: 수천 명의 오토바이 운전자, 빅토리아 주의회 앞 포트홀 시위 참여
items.title_original: Thousands of motorcyclists join pothole rally outside Victorian parliament

items.raw_excerpt: A Far North doctor is calling for a new postgraduate training pathway to better equip GPs for work in rural areas.
items.summary_en: A doctor in the Far North wants a new training pathway for rural GPs. It would help doctors get ready to work in remote areas. The goal is to improve health care in the region.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 파노스의 한 의사가 농촌 지역 GP를 위한 새 교육 과정이 필요하다고 말했습니다. 이 과정은 의사들이 외딴 지역에서 일할 준비를 돕습니다. 지역 의료 서비스를 개선하는 것이 목표입니다.
items.title_en: Rural doctor calls for new GP training pathway
items.title_ko: 파노스 지역 의사, 농촌 GP 교육 과정 신설 촉구
items.title_original: New postgraduate training pathway needed for rural GPs - doctor
